import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_data = df.copy()
sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=80)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', framealpha=0.9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation (Top 10)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True).tail(10)
ax2.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[0])
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep (hrs)', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 10 Occupations\nby Sleep Duration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                     s=60, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. BMI Category Distribution by Gender
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_gender = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Gender'])
bmi_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=[colors[2], colors[4]], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.legend(title='Gender', framealpha=0.9)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 5. Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sleep_disorder_hr = df.copy()
sleep_disorder_hr['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_hr['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorders = sleep_disorder_hr['Sleep Disorder'].unique()
hr_data = [sleep_disorder_hr[sleep_disorder_hr['Sleep Disorder'] == d]['Heart Rate'].values 
           for d in disorders]
bp = ax5.boxplot(hr_data, labels=disorders, patch_artist=True, widths=0.6)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30, labelsize=8)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 6. Daily Steps vs Sleep Duration
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax6.hexbin(df['Daily Steps'], df['Sleep Duration'], gridsize=25, cmap='YlOrRd', mincnt=1)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Sleep Duration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 7. Age Distribution by Gender
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax7.hist(subset['Age'], bins=15, alpha=0.6, label=gender, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax7.legend(title='Gender', framealpha=0.9)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 8. Correlation Heatmap of Numeric Variables
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'size': 7})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax8.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
